verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents hardware-isolated Fly Machines that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands, can be launched in one line via `fly machine run` or the REST API, and offers per-agent Sprites with checkpoints and their own HTTPS URLs. These are strong primitives for creating many isolated environments. However, nothing documents a team-oriented workflow such as per-developer or per-branch preview environments, and one hands-on report says moving staging environments to Fly failed on 70-80% of pushes. Missing for 10: documented per-developer/per-branch environment workflow, team concurrency or limits documentation, independent corroboration that spinning up many environments works reliably.
